label: bvp_shopify_memo
draft:
Shopify (the "Company") is a Canadian e-commerce platform serving small and medium businesses, founded in 2007 in Ottawa. The Company has grown rapidly, with customers increasing from 5'500 a year ago to nearly 10'000 today. Monthly recurring revenue has grown from USD 164'000 to USD 438'000 over the same period, representing growth of more than 150% year on year. The Company is profitable and has raised just USD 1 million to date.

Shopify's strategic moat is its App Store, which two-thirds of customers actively use. The product is simple enough that a non-technical user can set up a fully functioning online store within a few hours. Customer acquisition has been almost entirely organic, with paid marketing remaining underdeveloped — paid channels account for 10-15% of sign-ups. We see significant headroom to accelerate growth through marketing investment, international expansion, and continued development of the App Store ecosystem.

The team, led by founder-CEO Mr. Lütke, has demonstrated strong product and management instincts despite Mr. Lütke being a first-time CEO. Shopify's 24 employees are based in Ottawa, where the Company has recruited strong design and engineering talent at 60-70% of comparable Silicon Valley or New York costs.

In summary, Shopify combines exceptional unit economics, a defensible competitive position, and clear growth runway. We recommend approval.
